figures.caption: M3a — 3-class charge probe balanced-accuracy + AUROC by early block; all 4 sampled blocks (0, 2, 4, 6) achieve bacc=1.0 and AUROC=1.0 with permutation p<0.001. Chance = 1/3 (dotted line).

C3b two-panel: (a) target-region hairpin rate stays flat ≈0.99 across β ∈ {-3,-1,0,+1,+3}·σ_proj for both same and opposite configurations — a real null (175/179 chains hairpin=1 throughout the sweep); (b) mean ΔpLDDT vs β confirms the perturbation itself is non-zero, so the null in (a) is NOT a no-op — steering along v_charge does perturb the residual stream but does not deflect downstream folding decisions. Illustrates decodability ≠ causal sufficiency.
